title: convert_tiff_to_zarr pipeline parameters
description: Convert large multi-channel TIFF images to OME-Zarr using ngff-zarr

input_dir.help_text: All files ending in .tif or .tiff (including .ome.tif / .ome.tiff) in this directory are discovered automatically. Each file is converted as an independent parallel job.

outdir.description: Output directory. OME-Zarr stores are written to outdir/zarr/, logs to outdir/logs/

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used by Nextflow publishDir to stage output files

method.description: Downsampling method for multiscale pyramid generation
method.help_text: itkwasm_gaussian (default) is web-compatible and recommended for fluorescence images. Use a label_image method for segmentation masks.

chunks.description: Chunk size(s) for the Zarr arrays. Single integer for uniform chunking or space-separated integers per dimension, e.g. '64' or '1 64 64'
chunks.help_text: Defaults to ngff-zarr's automatic chunk size selection (128 px for 3-D, 256 px for 2-D).

chunks_per_shard.description: Number of chunks per shard (enables Zarr v3 sharding). Single integer or space-separated per dimension, e.g. '4' or '2 4 4'
chunks_per_shard.help_text: Default '4' packs ~64 chunks per shard for 3-D data, dramatically reducing on-disk file count and inode usage. Only supported with --ome_zarr_version 0.5. Set to '1' or null to disable sharding.

codec.help_text: Defaults to blosc:zstd which gives strong compression with fast decode — keeps OME-Zarr stores small enough to fit on scratch quotas. Use 'none' to disable compression (not recommended for large images).

compression_level.description: Compression level (codec-dependent, e.g. 1–9 for gzip, 1–22 for zstd)

series.description: Series to convert from multi-series OME-TIFF files. Can be: integer index (0, 1, 2), glob name pattern ('*GFP*'), or omit for all series
series.help_text: When omitted (default), all series in a multi-series TIFF are converted and written to separate OME-Zarr stores.

memory_target.description: Memory budget passed to ngff-zarr for internal caching decisions, e.g. '32GB'. Separate from the Nextflow job memory limit.
memory_target.help_text: When image data exceeds this threshold, ngff-zarr will spill to disk via --cache_dir.

cache_dir.description: Directory for ngff-zarr's disk cache when processing datasets larger than memory_target

use_tensorstore.description: Use the TensorStore library for I/O (faster for very large datasets)

dims.description: Override the dimension labels, space-separated, e.g. 'c z y x'
dims.help_text: Valid dimension labels: t, z, y, x, c

scale.description: Override the pixel spacing (scale) per dimension as dim-value pairs, e.g. 'z 4.0 y 0.5 x 0.5'

units.description: Override the physical units per spatial dimension as dim-unit pairs, e.g. 'z micrometer y micrometer x micrometer'

name.description: Image name to embed in the OME-Zarr metadata

no_omero.description: Disable automatic OMERO channel display metadata computation

omero_quantile_low.description: Lower quantile for OMERO channel window start (default: 0.02)

omero_quantile_high.description: Upper quantile for OMERO channel window end (default: 0.98)
